messages:
maya (oncall): Pagerduty fired for elevated 5xxs to the gateway from us-east-1 — big spike starting ~11:17 UTC. Notified SREs and FYI to product/support.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0421. Severity: P1. Paging maya, sam.
maya (oncall): I'm on it. Initial dashboard shows 502/504s from /v1/generate, error ratio ~12% on the gateway tier, request latency climbing.
sam (sre): Looking at ingress proxy logs now. I see heavy retry amplification to runtime -> multiple 429/503s from model-pool leading to gateway 502s.
tim (runtime): Can you paste a correlation id? I want to trace into the runtime traces.
sam (sre): Example request log: `correlation_id=cr-0ab3f2f7 level=error path=/v1/generate upstream=runtime-01 proto=http/1.1 status=502 latency_ms=1421 retries=4`
maya (oncall): Customer impact: Support queue shows ~80 affected requests across 9 customers; no clear permanent failures yet but high latency and surfaced 5xx for chat UIs. Nina - any VIPs flagged?
nina (product): Not a single tenant outage yet; highest traffic from ChatWidget orgs. Putting a banner on status for degraded response.
dave (support): Fielding a few customer tickets, sending a template note. Want ETA?
maya (oncall): No ETA yet. Need a mitigation path. Hypothesis A: recent gateway retry policy change (edge-retry-agg) is amplifying retries; Hypothesis B: runtime autoscale latency from a failed model reload.
tim (runtime): I see a config change rolled 11:12 UTC to gateway retry-backoff from 200ms->50ms (change id cfg-7482). That would increase rapid retries.
sam (sre): Correlating: spike started ~11:17, matches config rollout window. Retry chatter to runtime spiked at 11:15.
maya (oncall): Suggestion: fast rollback of cfg-7482 to previous backoff. Can ops-bot do a rollback runbook?
ops-bot: Runbook `gateway-fast-rollback` invoked by maya at 11:34 UTC. Step 1: disable feature flag `edge-retry-agg` on prod.
tim (runtime): I can confirm rollback of `edge-retry-agg` will stop aggressive client retries. Preparing a canary rollback to prod-traffic path A.
sam (sre): While rollback runs, open a narrow mitigation: reduce gateway concurrency to avoid queueing? That might throttle throughput.
maya (oncall): Prioritize rollback first. Sam, start smoke checks post-rollback and watch for 5xx drop and p50/p95 drop.
dave (support): I'll update customers: "We observed transient elevated errors; engineering is applying a rollback and monitoring".
ops-bot: Feature flag `edge-retry-agg` disabled at 11:38 UTC by tim.
sam (sre): Seeing immediate drop in retries to runtime. Gateway 5xx ratio down from 12% -> 2% at 11:42. Latency recovering.
tim (runtime): Runtime instance traces show reduced saturation on model-pool; queue lengths down. 
maya (oncall): Good. Marking mitigation: rollback successful. Start timeline build:
- 11:12 UTC cfg-7482 rollout change to retry-backoff (50ms)
- 11:15 UTC increased retry attempts observed at edge
- 11:17 UTC spike in gateway 502/504s, error ratio up
- 11:34 UTC P1 declared, pager fired
- 11:38 UTC feature flag disabled (rollback)
- 11:42 UTC 5xx ratio falling, latency recovering

maya (oncall): Action items for RCA thread: capture full set of gateway logs for 11:10-11:50 (sam), collect runtime qlen and model pool metrics (tim), list of changed configs and release diffs (tim + infra), customer impact summary (dave + nina).
sam (sre): I'm exporting logs filtered by correlation prefix `cr-` and will drop into the incident artifacts bucket: s3://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-0421/gateway-logs.zip
tim (runtime): Exporting runtime traces and heap/mem charts to same bucket. Also saving kube rollout history for cfg-7482.
dave (support): Drafting customer email; will attach short timeline and next steps.
maya (oncall): Hypothesis tracking: H1 (primary) = aggressive retry config rollout cfg-7482 caused retry amplification -> runtime saturation -> gateway 502s. H2 = unrelated model reload pressure. Current evidence strongly favors H1 (temporal correlation + immediate mitigation effect).
nina (product): Please assign owners for RCA doc and postmortem. I can coordinate severity notes and external comms.
maya (oncall): Owner: sam for RCA technical timeline + logs, tim for runtime analysis, nina for comms, dave for customer impact. I'll close the P1 once postmortem links are created.
sam (sre): One more artifact: sample request trace `cr-0ab3f2f7` shows 4 retries within 200ms windows before failing. Pasting trace link: https://traces.internal.redwood/traces/cr-0ab3f2f7
tim (runtime): Noted. Also let's add a short-term rule to throttle retry bursts at gateway ingress to avoid future amplification. I'll open a ticket.
maya (oncall): Thanks everyone. I'll leave this thread as the live mitigation log. After RCA draft, we'll create a postmortem with timeline + preventative measures (rate-limiting backoff, rollout guardrails).
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0421 updated: status -> mitigated, 11:45 UTC.
maya (oncall): Closing live coordination. Keep thread for artifacts drop and RCA follow-ups.
